draft_text: On the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, Tessaline significantly outperformed Varrow-NMT in BLEU (28.4 vs 27.6 over 8 seeds).
revised_text: On the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, Tessaline achieved a higher mean BLEU than Varrow-NMT (28.4 ± 0.6 vs 27.6 ± 0.8 over 8 seeds).
rationale: The BLEU means (T1.r1.bleu, T1.r2.bleu) support a higher-mean claim, but the only reported statistical test (S1) is for Tessaline vs PhraseGrid (cmp2), not vs Varrow-NMT (cmp1). No test supports "significantly" for this comparison, so the significance claim must be removed.
